description: Na₄TaIn(SiO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.99 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.49 Å) and three longer (2.65 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.98 Å) and three longer (2.05 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.08 Å) and three longer (2.19 Å) In-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-37°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.68 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na, one In, and one Si atom to form distorted face-sharing ONa₃InSi trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one In, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ta, and one Si atom.
